basic_info.description: This is the best-in-Class... this House-Like Condo / Townhouse lives on 2-Levels with TWO car parking and and exclusive backyard next to large communal backyard for the building. This is NEW CONSTRUCTION circa 2004 so insurance is all clear here. 2 Bedrooms on separate floors for amazing privacy. Secure and Extremely well engineered building on solid bedrock. Location is a 11 out of 10 with easy access to South Bay / Peninsula and Downtown on the J train or BART. Dolores Park. Amazing Weather.  Market on the block!   Love SF!!
